newsitem.title: INDIA: Mother Teresa taken home from hospital.
newsitem.headline: Mother Teresa taken home from hospital.

text.p: Mother Teresa was released from hospital on Wednesday and taken back to her religious order after being given a clean bill of health, a doctor treating the revered Roman Catholic missionary said.

Eyes closed and hands folded, the 86-year-old nun, who was taken to hospital last week after falling from a chair, was carried on a stretcher into the Missionaries of Charity order where nuns greeted her with applause, witnesses said.

"God bless you," Mother Teresa said to Sister Frederica, the order's second-ranking nun, as she was carried from an ambulance into the Missionaries of Charity headquarters, her home in the eastern Indian city of Calcutta.
To the sound of the chapel bell, about 30 nuns surrounded Mother Teresa and sang and danced in joy before she was taken to the order's prayer room, witnesses said.
Later Mother Teresa, wearing her traditional white and blue-trimmed sari, was carried to her room where she was examined by a doctor, they said.
A doctor said Mother Teresa was carried on a stretcher because of longstanding back pain and not because of any lingering effects from the fall onto her head that she suffered on September 16.
"There is no cause for concern," said Dr A.K. Bardhan of Woodlands Nursing Home where she had undergone treatment.
He said a brain scan earlier on Wednesday at nearby Belview Nursing Home showed a blood clot detected last week had disappeared.
"The blood clot detected in the first scan has been completely dissolved after 10 days of medication," he told reporters.
Sister Priscilla, a senior nun, said Mother Teresa was resting in bed. "We are very happy. We are grateful to God that she is back," she said.
The 1979 Nobel Peace Prize winner has spent two stints in hospital in the past month.
She spent nearly three weeks at Woodlands Nursing Home in late August and early September for heart trouble, malaria and pneumonia.
Less than two weeks after she returned to her religious order, Mother Teresa fell off a chair and hit her head.
Doctors discovered a spot on her brain last week, but Bardhan said it had since dissolved.
